text: Following this, a plenary session of the extraordinary session will be held at 16:00.
In connection with the Easter holiday, travel by metro and bus in Tbilisi will be free.

In connection with the Easter holiday, the Tbilisi Metro will operate until 04:00 on April 12, and travel will be free from 23:00 on April 11 until 04:00 on April 12. This information was released by the Tbilisi City Hall.
Furthermore, by the decision of the City Hall, nine temporary bus routes have also been established for April 12-13.
“Buses will transport passengers from 08:00 to 20:00 to the Mukhatgverdi, Vashlijvari, Kukia, New Kukia, Makhata, Saburtalo, Grmaghele, Veli, and Varketili cemeteries.

Buses will operate from the Marjanishvili, Delisi, and Sarajishvili metro stations, the area adjacent to Varketili metro station, the upper exit of Didube metro station, Station Square (opposite Tbilisi Central), Besarion Chichinadze Street (opposite Building No. 25), and Varketili III Massif—from the intersection of Shuamta and Abashvili streets.
"Citizens will be able to use the buses on the mentioned routes free of charge for two days," – the information from Tbilisi City Hall states.
